_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Player {player_id}, di ko jëfandikoo {num_rounds} tours ci Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ndaw si ${pool} ngone la ñuy séddale ci benn tour bi ci ndaw si ak Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Defare offrande: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Suñu njëkk → Yaa ngone $(pool - X), beneen player bi njëkk $X
  - Suñu bàyyi → Ñeneen njëkk $0
  - Seetu: [Offer: $3]  mbaa  'Ma xalaat ne dëgg. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Tànn offrande bi ak [Accept] mbaa [Reject]
  - Seetu: 'Dafa xélit. [Accept]'
            'Too ñaax. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ronn {round_number} daal! ---
Jëfandikukat {proposer_id} mooy ki jëfandikoo, Jëfandikukat {responder_id} mooy ki bàyyi.
round.accepted: Jëfandikukat {responder_id} nangu! Ronn {round_number} yéwénen: Jëfandikukat {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Jëfandikukat {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Yéwénen yu bees: Jëfandikukat 0: ${total_0}, Jëfandikukat 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Jëfandikukat {responder_id} bàyyi ofri! Ronn {round_number} yéwénen: Ñaar ñi jëfandikoo +$0. Yéwénen yu bees waxul: Jëfandikukat 0: ${total_0}, Jëfandikukat 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Ku bëgg a def ab joowukaay, war na jëfandikoo jëfekaayu [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Jëfandikukat bu nekk war na am solo.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jëf bi war na nekk ci diggante $0 ak ${pool} .
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Amul benn laaj bu ñu may ngir tontu.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder bi war naa [Accept] mbaa [Reject] offrande bi.

outcome.win: Jëfandikukat {winner} jànge ci ${winner_total} ci wàllug Jëfandikukat {loser} ci ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Ginnaaw bi, ñaari xët yi dañu am ${total} ci lu mat.
